data.gender_notes: Qudsiah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Qudsiah is derived from 'Quds', referring to Jerusalem, a sacred city in Islam. It signifies purity and holiness. The name Qudsiah carries the meaning “Holy, Sacred, Pure” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Qudsiah usually hope their child will grow to embody holy, sacred, pure and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Al-Quds (Jerusalem) is considered a holy city, and the name Qudsiah reflects a connection to this sacred place, symbolizing spiritual purity.
data.etymology: Qudsiah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Holy, Sacred, Pure.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Qudsiah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
